$comment: APPAuto QA mobile visual tokens. Android maps these to Jetpack Compose Material3; iOS maps the same semantic tokens to SwiftUI, with liquid glass material enabled for elevated surfaces.

brand.name: APPAuto QA
brand.visualStyle: modern operational tool with soft depth, crisp typography, and semantic status color

screen.background: soft vertical gradient; no decorative blobs; content remains dense and scannable

topBar.android: background surface blends into screen; no heavy shadow
topBar.ios: liquid glass floating bar when scrolling content passes under it

bottomNav.android: white Material3 navigation bar with primaryContainer selected indicator
bottomNav.ios: glass tab bar, ultraThinMaterial, 18 radius on floating compact layouts

glassPanel.ios: liquid glass material with white stroke and subtle highlight

pill.usage: ids, status, short metadata, segmented options

button.primary: primary fill, white text, 50dp/50pt height on forms
button.secondary: white or glass fill, border surface.border, primary text
button.danger: danger text or dangerContainer fill for destructive confirmation

listCard.android: flat card with 1dp border; use 2dp tonal elevation only for active/selected states
listCard.ios: glass only for navigation/floating panels; ordinary list rows use clean card surfaces

rules: Use motion to confirm state changes, not as decoration.
List refresh and tab changes should be under 300ms.
Pressed controls scale subtly only on iOS glass components.

implementationRules: Do not use gradient blobs, decorative orbs, or marketing-style hero cards.
Cards use 8dp radius by default; pill controls are the only fully rounded shape.
Status colors are semantic and must not replace the primary brand color.
Keep operational screens dense, with filters above lists and actions close to the affected item.
Use native icons for actions instead of emoji text.
Android glass is a lightweight approximation; iOS owns the true liquid glass material.
